label.it: Celle che si muovono più dei dintorni
label.en: Cells that move more than their surroundings

question: Which cells move against the rest of this box?
headline: moving

reference.meaning: median of the box, the reference; vertical: positive up, negative down (subsidence)

moving.meaning: cells 5.0 mm/a or more from the reference

moving_reliable.meaning: of them, cells with enough measured cells around

coverage.meaning: share of the cells in the box that have a value

reliability.method: egms-client: the share of the 100 m cells in the box that have a value

notes: A cell moves when it differs from the median of the box by the threshold.
The data stop at the end of the window: they do not describe the ground of today.
A ground velocity is a measurement, not an alert or a safety verdict.
